proposals.action_title: Publish first 3 Coloring Books on Amazon KDP using Together AI (FLUX-schnell)
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline is ready. Together AI offers a free tier for FLUX-schnell which generates high-quality black and white outlines. KDP has no listing fees, meaning 100% net margin on organic sales.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline using TOGETHER_API_KEY on GitHub Actions to generate 30 coloring pages on a trending niche (e.g., 'cozy hygge rooms' or 'simple mandalas').

proposals.action_title: Bulk-upload 100 Minimalist Typography Designs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Bypasses the current AI image generation bottleneck entirely. Text-based designs (funny quotes, local idioms, niche professions) sell exceptionally well on t-shirts and mugs, require zero GPU budget, and can be bulk-generated using simple Python scripts on Termux.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a 20-line Python script in Termux to generate 100 transparent PNG text designs using PIL (Pillow) with trendy free-commercial-use fonts.

proposals.action_title: Launch 5 Parametric OpenSCAD 3D Models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is registered but empty. Functional, parametric 3D models (e.g., custom drawer organizers, cable clips, gridfinity modules) have high search volume and conversion rates from 3D printing enthusiasts who value utility over aesthetics.
proposals.first_action_today: Upload 3 existing parametric STL files generated via the 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline, pricing them at a competitive €1.99 to €2.99.

proposals.action_title: Publish 5 Niche 2D Game Asset Packs on itch.io (Pay-What-You-Want)
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly search itch.io for prototyping assets. By offering UI kits, seamless textures, or 2D sprites under a Pay-What-You-Want model with a suggested price of $2.00, you capture both free traffic and generous backers.
proposals.first_action_today: Package 5 sets of UI buttons or pattern backgrounds generated via the 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' pipeline into zip files and create your itch.io seller profile.

proposals.action_title: Implement 'Loss-Leader' Launch Pricing on first KDP Low-Content Books
proposals.why_this_works_now: New KDP listings have zero organic rank. Pricing your initial books at the absolute printing minimum (e.g., €4.49 for a notebook, yielding ~€0.05 royalty) triggers the Amazon A9 algorithm through early conversions, paving the way to raise prices to €6.99 later.
proposals.first_action_today: Adjust the metadata and pricing of your pending low-content book drafts to the minimum allowed price on the KDP dashboard.
